rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail baseline by spending the remaining export headroom on the only recurrent-tail attention value matrix still forced through int8: the penultimate repeated block c_v. The current best already keeps tail Q/K plus the final block V in FP16; adding the adjacent V tensor makes the two reverse recurrent passes less asymmetric while leaving the training loop, recurrence curriculum, data path, validation path, and final exact int8+zlib evaluation unchanged. The modified script is self-contained and executes the expanded current-best source with this surgical export-budget edit.
title: Penultimate Tail Value FP16 Rescue
